_about: Team-reported injuries Sleeper hasn't caught up to yet. The build marks each player out until back_week (the first week he can play) and treats out_from (optional) as the first week he misses, and drops the entry by itself once that week arrives or Sleeper lists him on IR. back_week 19 means out for the rest of the season; season (optional) limits an entry to that NFL season so it can't carry into the next one. Remove an entry if the news changes.

9493.name: Puka Nacua
9493.note: Having MCL surgery; likely out for the rest of the 2026 season. Expected back for 2027.
